
### labels aren't enough? 

![](/cfi/texfig/cfg-unions.figure.svg){fig-alt="control-flow-graph diagram showing calls from foo and bar through function pointers. foo can call A and B; bar can call B and C. A check for a label is listed before each call and a label is listed at the beginning of A, B, C, but the label is left as question marks."}

::: {.myoverbox .fragment fragment-index=1 .fade-in .right}

two possible fixes:

*  allow foo to call B<br/>
   (easier to attack)

*  scan for multiple labels<br/>
   (more overhead)

:::
